narrative.overview:
This portfolio embodies a refined, dimly-lit creative workshop where craft is revealed through careful illumination. The dark canvas (#1f2020) creates a focused, distraction-free environment that puts Milena's work center stage. Professional warmth emerges not through decoration but through precise, human-centered interactions — every hover state, every transition, every glow effect serves a purpose.

The aesthetic philosophy is confident restraint: a near-monochrome base with a single chromatic accent (Signal Orange) that cuts through the darkness with intent. Technical competence is demonstrated through clean code and smooth animations, while human approachability lives in the soft, tactile component language and warm ambient depth.
keyCharacteristics: Dark, focused canvas that eliminates visual noise
Single chromatic accent (Signal Orange) for purposeful direction
Soft, pill-shaped components with dramatic hover interactions
Ambient depth through shadows and radial glow effects

rules.name: The Signal Orange Rule
rules.body: The primary accent appears on ≤15% of any given screen. Its rarity is the point — it draws the eye to interactive moments, not decorative surfaces.

rules.name: The System Font Rule
rules.body: Typography stays in the system font stack — no external font loads. Performance and consistency across platforms outweigh decorative ambition.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, elevation, focus) or as ambient environmental effects (hero glow).

rules.name: The Pill Shape Rule
rules.body: Interactive elements that trigger actions (buttons, toggles, chips) use pill shapes. Content containers (cards, contact items) use softer but not full rounding.

dos: Do use Signal Orange sparingly — only for interactive highlights and directional cues
Do maintain the pill shape (999px radius) for all interactive triggers (buttons, chips, toggles)
Do use ambient depth (hero glow, hover shadows) to create atmospheric layering
Do keep the near-monochrome base — the dark canvas is the brand identity
Do use smooth, deliberate transitions (0.3s–0.6s) for all interactive states
Do center content in the 1100px container with generous vertical rhythm (5rem sections)
donts: Don't add chromatic colors beyond Signal Orange — the palette is intentionally limited
Don't use sharp corners on interactive elements — pill shapes are the component language
Don't apply shadows at rest — flat surfaces are the default state
Don't exceed 15% screen coverage with the orange accent — its rarity is the point
Don't use decorative typography — the system font stack is a performance and consistency choice
Don't break the vertical rhythm — 5rem section spacing creates the breathing room
